title: Ups and downs
hints: Turn the samples into steps first: `[b - a for a, b in pairwise(elevations)]`. Everything else is computed from that list.
Ascent and descent are filtered sums over the steps. For the longest climb, `groupby(steps, key=lambda d: d > 0)` gives you runs of rising steps. Sum each rising run and take the largest.
longest = max((sum(run) for rising, run in groupby(steps, key=lambda d: d > 0) if rising), default=0)
